name: Fable
vendor: Fable (Fable Group Inc.; now one team with Everand)
why_listed: Readers who want book clubs with spoiler-free chapter rooms and highlights shared inside the ebook with their group would use Fable instead of Spoken Margins for social, anchored discussion.

platforms.detail: Phone and tablet apps; books and clubs are not available on the web.

sources.title: Fable: Track & Discuss Books App - App Store
sources.quote: iPhone, iPad

sources.title: Fable: Track & Discuss Books - Apps on Google Play
sources.quote: Join a community of good people discussing great stories on Fable, an app designed to find, discuss, and track books and TV shows.

sources.title: Can I read books on my laptop? Can I access my club discussion on a computer? - Fable Reader Support
sources.quote: For now, books and clubs can only be accessed using a smartphone or tablet.

platforms.note: The help centre also lists a beta Chrome browser extension, not read. fable.co itself is a JavaScript app that returned no readable text to curl.

price_free_tier.value: Free: tracking, lists, streaks, reviews, free book and TV clubs, interactive ebook reader (ebooks bought separately; free classics)
price_free_tier.detail: Core app is free; ebooks are sold individually.

sources.title: Will Fable continue to be free unless I choose to upgrade? - Fable Reader Support
sources.quote: Yes. Fable will remain free to use, with the same option to upgrade to Fable Plus for those who want extra features.

sources.title: Fable: Track & Discuss Books App - App Store
sources.quote: Explore thousands of free book and TV clubs for every niche interest

price_paid.detail: Fable Plus adds advanced stats, custom goals, badges and no ads; it is also included with any Everand subscription (from USD 11.99 in the US).

sources.title: How much does Fable Plus cost? Are there any discounts or promotions on Fable Plus? - Fable Reader Support
sources.quote: The monthly plan costs $5.99 USD/mo, and the annual plan costs $49.99 USD.

share_note_at_moment.detail: In a club's Social Mode, members see each other's highlights and comments in place in the book; notes stay private. Quotes can also be shared as images.

sources.title: What is Social Mode? - Fable Reader Support
sources.quote: You'll be able to see your group's highlights, add your own, and even start discussions right from the book.

sources.title: Can members of my Club see my notes? - Fable Reader Support
sources.quote: All your notes are always private, so no one you're reading with will be able to see them.

share_note_at_moment.note: Only within Fable club books, text only.
